about: Systems C programmer focused on networking and low-level Linux internals. 4+ years of production C across router firmware, NAT subsystems, and network virtualization. Comfortable with kernel-adjacent tooling - eBPF, NFQ, io_uring - and across the day-to-day of systems work: debugging, profiling, packaging, and operational glue.

experience.description: Work in C on the disk subsystem of a distributed block storage product, contributing inside the SPDK codebase.
achievements: Currently building Prometheus metrics integration for the SPDK service - runtime observability over the disk subsystem
Added custom SPDK commands and RPCs for disk management - volume splits, RAID creation/management, and related operations
Designed and implemented a disk heartbeat mechanism across nodes on the multi-node test stand, used to detect disk-level connectivity issues
Added on-disk metadata for disks and RAID volumes, used to recover and reconfigure previously-added disks from their stored metadata on restart
Added automatic versioning for individual SPDK modules, so binary compatibility issues can be detected at runtime
Maintained the SPDK service: RPM .spec packaging and systemd units
Fixed a lock-up in SPDK's NVMe connection path that occurred when reaching a disk that had become unreachable over the network
Diagnosed and fixed several memory leaks across the disk subsystem using AddressSanitizer

experience.description: Continued on the same firmware codebase; scope expanded to the NAT subsystem and the eNSP Pro Lite network simulator.
achievements: Led the local NAT effort on the router with a small team of two, coordinating with a remote colleague at Huawei China; added the full CLI control surface for NAT configuration, refactored and extended ALG handling in legacy code for FTP, PPTP, RTSP and other protocols, and added new ALGs where needed
Extended eNSP Pro Lite (enterprise network simulation platform) from its initial device set to cover our AP, SOHO router, IoT devices, and mobile stations
Implemented virtual wireless connectivity inside the simulator using NFQ packet redirection and eBPF; added a link / physical state protocol for virtual connections
Simulated wireless environment effects - distance-based signal strength, packet loss, link-state changes - and station roaming, so mobile devices always associate with the strongest available AP
Built ubridge (a variation of ebridge) for joining interfaces across virtual devices into a single bridge, allowing eNSP Pro Lite to interoperate with external network simulators

Partnered with DevOps to build a pytest + scapy system-test framework: drive a QEMU-hosted SOHO via configuration fixtures, then validate NAT and IP routing behaviour against captured traffic (scapy, Wireshark)

experience.description: Worked on firmware in C for AP, IoT, and SOHO router devices, focused on the CLI / control plane.
achievements: Implemented IP address configuration and dynamic enable/disable of IP routes on address changes; added handling for link and physical/logical addresses
Built an ARP table with binary-tree fast lookup over an auto-expanding storage layer
Wrote GoogleTest unit tests covering the ARP table and surrounding control-plane code - lookup correctness, growth behaviour, edge cases
